# anthropic Provider

The Anthropic provider manages administrative resources across **Claude Console** (Workspaces, Workspace Members, Users, Invites, API Keys), **Claude Enterprise** (RBAC Groups, RBAC Group Members, RBAC Roles, Per-User Spend Limits), and **Workload Identity Federation (WIF)** (Service Accounts, Federation Issuers, Federation Rules) using the official Anthropic Go SDK (`github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-go`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    anthropic = {
      source = "mozilla/anthropic"
    }
  }
}

# Option 1: Static Organization Admin API Key (Claude Console & Enterprise resources;
# note that Service Accounts and WIF resources require Option 2 or Option 3).
# Set ANTHROPIC_ADMIN_API_KEY in the environment (`sk-ant-admin01-...`).
provider "anthropic" {
  # api_key     = var.anthropic_admin_api_key
  # base_url    = "https://api.anthropic.com"
  # max_retries = 3
}

# Option 2: OAuth Bearer Token with `org:admin` scope (supports all resources including WIF).
# Set ANTHROPIC_OAUTH_TOKEN or ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN in the environment.
# provider "anthropic" {
#   oauth_token = var.anthropic_oauth_token
# }

# Option 3: Workload Identity Federation (WIF) via OIDC JWT token exchange
# (supports all resources including Service Accounts, Federation Issuers, and Federation Rules).
# provider "anthropic" {
#   federation = {
#     federation_rule_id  = var.federation_rule_id     # or ANTHROPIC_FEDERATION_RULE_ID
#     organization_id     = var.organization_id        # or ANTHROPIC_ORGANIZATION_ID
#     service_account_id  = var.service_account_id     # or ANTHROPIC_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_ID
#     identity_token_file = "/var/run/secrets/oidc/token" # or ANTHROPIC_IDENTITY_TOKEN_FILE / ANTHROPIC_IDENTITY_TOKEN
#   }
# }
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Anthropic Admin API key (`sk-ant-admin...`). Defaults to `ANTHROPIC_ADMIN_API_KEY`. Note: Service Account and Workload Identity Federation endpoints reject static Admin API keys and require `oauth_token` or `federation`.
- `base_url` (String) Base URL for the Anthropic API. Defaults to `https://api.anthropic.com`. Must use `https`, except `http` on a loopback host for local testing. Intentionally does not read `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` from the environment to prevent credential exfiltration via ambient proxy variables.
- `federation` (Attributes) Workload Identity Federation (WIF) configuration for exchanging an external OIDC JWT (e.g. GitHub Actions, GCP, AWS, Kubernetes) for a short-lived Anthropic OAuth access token via `POST /v1/oauth/token`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--federation))
- `max_retries` (Number) Maximum number of retries on HTTP 429 rate-limit or 5xx/529 transient errors. Defaults to `4`.
- `oauth_token` (String, Sensitive) Anthropic OAuth access token (`sk-ant-oat01-...`) with `org:admin` scope. Defaults to `ANTHROPIC_OAUTH_TOKEN` (or `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN`). Required when managing Service Accounts or Federation resources without WIF.

<a id="nestedatt--federation"></a>
### Nested Schema for `federation`

Optional:

- `federation_rule_id` (String) Federation rule ID (`fdrl_...`). Defaults to `ANTHROPIC_FEDERATION_RULE_ID`.
- `identity_token` (String, Sensitive) Inline OIDC JWT assertion. Defaults to `ANTHROPIC_IDENTITY_TOKEN`. Mutually exclusive with `identity_token_file`.
- `identity_token_file` (String) Path to a file containing a rotating OIDC JWT assertion. Defaults to `ANTHROPIC_IDENTITY_TOKEN_FILE`.
- `organization_id` (String) Anthropic organization UUID. Defaults to `ANTHROPIC_ORGANIZATION_ID`.
- `service_account_id` (String) Optional target service account ID (`svac_...`). Defaults to `ANTHROPIC_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_ID`.
- `workspace_id` (String) Optional workspace ID (`wrkspc_...` or `default`). Defaults to `ANTHROPIC_WORKSPACE_ID`.
